tests.name: json_pointer_strong_exception_rollback
tests.intent: Verify that non-const operator[](json_pointer) leaves the JSON object completely unchanged when an exception occurs during pointer resolution.

tests.name: json_pointer_array_padding_rollback
tests.intent: Verify that padding an array via json_pointer does not leave intermediate elements if a subsequent token throws an exception.

tests.name: json_pointer_object_insertion_rollback
tests.intent: Verify that object key insertion via json_pointer rolls back cleanly if a nested token resolution throws an exception.

tests.name: json_pointer_dash_operator_append
tests.intent: Verify successful append behavior using the dash ("-") reference token with non-const operator[].

tests.name: json_pointer_null_conversion_rollback
tests.intent: Verify that converting a null value during pointer creation is successfully rolled back if a later token fails.

tests.name: json_pointer_unresolved_primitive
tests.intent: Check behavior when a JSON pointer tries to traverse into a non-object/non-array primitive value.

tests.name: json_pointer_array_index_overflow
tests.intent: Verify exception behavior and state preservation when an array index exceeds numeric limits.

tests.name: json_pointer_leading_zero_array_index
tests.intent: Verify parse error when an array index starts with '0' (other than '0' itself) on an existing array.

tests.name: json_pointer_concatenate_and_traverse
tests.intent: Verify concatenation of json_pointers using operator/ and subsequent retrieval.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_token
tests.intent: Verify behavior of JSON pointers containing empty tokens (e.g., object keys that are empty strings).

tests.name: json_pointer_escaped_characters
tests.intent: Verify parsing and resolution of JSON pointers with escaped characters (~0 for ~ and ~1 for /).

tests.name: json_pointer_comparison_operators
tests.intent: Check equality and relative order comparisons between json_pointer objects.

tests.name: json_pointer_stream_insertion
tests.intent: Verify streaming a json_pointer to an std::ostream.

tests.name: json_pointer_parent_and_pop
tests.intent: Verify pop_back and top operations on json_pointer.

tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_conversion
tests.intent: Verify to_string method and implicit/explicit conversions of json_pointer.

tests.name: json_pointer_unsupported_type_assignment
tests.intent: Verify exception safety when assigning through a pointer that encounters type conflicts.

tests.name: json_pointer_with_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer operations with nlohmann::ordered_json container type.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_pointer
tests.intent: Verify behavior of an empty json_pointer referencing the root document.

tests.name: json_pointer_multiple_backtracking_guards
tests.intent: Verify correct rollback behavior when nested creations trigger multiple potential failure points.

tests.name: json_pointer_exception_messages
tests.intent: Capture exception types and error codes thrown by invalid json_pointer usages.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise is_less_comparator and finds_equal_keys traits with standard and custom object types, and invoke object_search/object_search_found path with lower_bound/key_comp.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Trigger object_search_found_impl with priority_tag<1> and priority_tag<0> by using different map/object container configurations during json_pointer resolution.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise get_unchecked_rollback with array_grown and key_inserted branches by causing an exception during nested json_pointer creation on an existing array and object.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise array padding loop paths in get_unchecked and create_values where indices exceed current array size, leading to array_grown rollback or direct expansion.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise convert_null_to with object_t branch and array index token validation starting with '0' (is_array_index_token returning false).

tests.name: json_pointer_concatenate_and_traverse_fixed
tests.intent: Verify concatenation of json_pointers using operator/ and subsequent retrieval.

tests.name: gen_24_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise array padding loop paths in get_unchecked and create_values where indices exceed current array size, leading to array_grown rollback or direct expansion.
